integrity: The full 16-bit transition graph and polynomial-order checks are replayable from the included standard-library verifier. No claim of physical randomness or cryptographic security follows.
scientific_limitations: Exact autonomous synchronous bit-map only; excludes stochastic reseeding, hardware faults, alternative byte extraction and continuous-real dynamics. Later author thesis not independently reviewed in full; priority uncertainty remains. No independent mathematical validation.
title: A primitive 15-bit cycle hidden in the 16-bit XOR-perturbed digital tent map
